parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the results to return. The default value is **1**, which returns the first page of results.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: SearchType
parameters.description:
The query type. Valid values:

- **id**: Queries by rule group ID.

- **name**: Queries by rule group name. Both Chinese and English names are supported.
